crie.purpose: Strategy-selected keyword + semantic retrieval and candidate merge (§258/§458-461).

nodes.name: When Called by WF-002
nodes.notes: inputSource 'passthrough' (lowercase t) per the frozen SW I/O contract.

nodes.name: Embed Query
nodes.notes: §459 query embedding. Model must match the stored vectors (R-09 vector(1536)).

nodes.name: Attach Embedding
nodes.notes: Fails loudly on a dimension mismatch instead of letting Postgres error opaquely.

parameters.query: WITH q AS (SELECT '{{ JSON.stringify($('Attach Embedding').first().json.queryEmbedding) }}'::vector AS v) SELECT ku.id::text AS "knowledgeUnitId", e.id::text AS "evidenceId", cit.id::text AS "citationId", ku.content AS text, COALESCE(ku.authority_source, 'Internal Notes') AS "sourceType", ku.created_at AS "updatedAt", ku.category, ku.module, ku.feature, d.filename AS document, cit.page, cit.section, 1 - (emb.embedding <=> q.v) AS "semanticScore", 0::float AS "keywordScore", 0::float AS "metadataScore" FROM q, repository.embeddings emb JOIN repository.retrieval_chunks rc ON rc.id = emb.chunk_id JOIN repository.knowledge_units ku ON ku.id = rc.knowledge_unit_id LEFT JOIN repository.evidence e ON e.knowledge_unit_id = ku.id LEFT JOIN repository.citations cit ON cit.evidence_id = e.id LEFT JOIN repository.documents d ON d.id = cit.document_id WHERE 1 - (emb.embedding <=> q.v) >= {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.minimumSimilarity) }} ORDER BY emb.embedding <=> q.v LIMIT {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.topK) }};

nodes.name: Semantic Search
nodes.notes: §459 cosine search over the HNSW index (0013). minimumSimilarity and topK come from config.

parameters.query: SELECT ku.id::text AS "knowledgeUnitId", e.id::text AS "evidenceId", cit.id::text AS "citationId", ku.content AS text, COALESCE(ku.authority_source, 'Internal Notes') AS "sourceType", ku.created_at AS "updatedAt", ku.category, ku.module, ku.feature, d.filename AS document, cit.page, cit.section, 0::float AS "semanticScore", GREATEST( ts_rank(to_tsvector('simple', ku.content), plainto_tsquery('simple', $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordQuery }}$q$)), similarity(ku.content, $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordQuery }}$q$) )::float AS "keywordScore", 0::float AS "metadataScore" FROM repository.knowledge_units ku LEFT JOIN repository.evidence e ON e.knowledge_unit_id = ku.id LEFT JOIN repository.citations cit ON cit.evidence_id = e.id LEFT JOIN repository.documents d ON d.id = cit.document_id WHERE to_tsvector('simple', ku.content) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordQuery }}$q$) OR similarity(ku.content, $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordQuery }}$q$) > 0.1 ORDER BY "keywordScore" DESC LIMIT {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.topK) }};

nodes.name: Keyword Search
nodes.notes: §458 FTS + pg_trgm. Reads config and the query text from $('Attach Embedding') by node reference: the Semantic Search node upstream is a Postgres node and REPLACES the item, so $json.config is not available here.
